scenes.headline: You scroll. Then you hate that you scrolled.
scenes.voiceover: The scroll feels good for ten minutes. The guilt lasts all day.

scenes.headline: Do the thing you're avoiding.
scenes.voiceover: With Drift, you knock out the tasks you keep putting off.

scenes.headline: Every task buys you screen time.
scenes.voiceover: And every one pays you in minutes of screen time.

scenes.headline: The feeds can wait. They're locked.
scenes.voiceover: Until you've earned it, your feeds stay locked.

scenes.headline: Scroll happy.
scenes.voiceover: Drift. Earn your scroll. Enjoy it, too.
